evidence.reason: The test loops over three distinct exception names but assigns the same generated class to LiveBindingRefused, FactoryRefused, and CompletionError in every iteration. Each subTest therefore exercises only one class identity, so a handler that catches just one binding's exception can still pass all three cases. This is a test correctness defect, not a new requirement; defining three distinct classes and raising only the intended one is the minimal fix.
